status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Inlined into server.mjs by esbuild because neither is published: the engine is an unpublished candidate, and the comparison is TypeScript in the site repository. Bundling is what keeps one copy of the comparison rules rather than two.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1 through rc.8 are unchanged and still downloadable; this is a separate immutable archive. The engine inside it moves from 0.1.1-rc.8 to 0.1.1-rc.9, which adds nine house systems for twelve: whole sign, Placidus and Porphyry as before, and Koch, Regiomontanus, Campanus, Topocentric, Alcabitius, Equal, Vehlow, Meridian and Morinus, each as Swiss Ephemeris defines it. calculate_natal_chart now offers all twelve; it offered placidus and whole before. Koch, like Placidus, is undefined inside the polar circle, where the engine uses whole sign and the result reports both the request and the system used. Positions, angles and the records' conventions are unchanged, so records written by rc.3 to rc.8 still parse and compare. A record naming rc.8 is not re-run on this engine, so its differences stay hypotheses.
